title: fix(auth,app-shell): every sign-out clears the signed-out user's browser storage
body:
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:登出时清掉该用户会话在浏览器 localStorage / sessionStorage 里写下的全部键(列表状态、列表筛选、搜索词、最近访问等),所有登出路径都清;只保留设备类键(会话令牌、会话用户指针、主题)和登录页语言。
- 为什么改:这些键属于已登出的用户,登出后不应留在共用浏览器里;服务器上的用户偏好不动,换设备或重新登录仍能取回。
- 风险与回滚:风险在于清得过多——宿主应用若把自己的设置放在别的键下,登出时也会被清(换用户登录时本来就会被清)。会话读取未得到服务器应答(断网、5xx)不算登出,什么都不清。回滚即回退本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/auth/src/AuthProvider.tsx`(`loadSession` 里只在服务器答「无会话」时清理的那一段)、`ui/packages/auth/src/createAuthClient.ts`(`getSession` 记录本次读取是否得到服务器应答)、`ui/packages/auth/src/ActiveOrganizationStorage.ts`(`purgeSignedOutUserClientState` 与保留键名单)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/auth/src/__tests__/signOut-client-cache-purge-5198.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/context/__tests__/signOutPurge.test.tsx`,预期两个文件全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The rule: every sign-out clears the browser storage the signed-out user's session wrote, on every sign-out path, through one clearing helper.

- **`@object-ui/auth`.** `purgeSignedOutUserClientState` runs the same allowlist sweep a change of session user already runs (`sweepStore`), over `localStorage` and `sessionStorage`. Every key goes except the device keys (`auth-session-token`, `auth-session-user-id`, `vite-ui-theme`) and the sign-in page language (`objectui-locale`, `objectui-locale-seed`). That covers `list-state:USER:OBJECT` (`ListPreferencesProvider`), `list-filters:USER:OBJECT:VIEW` (`listFilterStorage`) and every other per-user key, including one added later, without a second key list.
- It runs on `signOut()` (account menu, header, remediation overlay), and on any session read the server answers with "no session" in a browser that has held one: a session that expired, was revoked or was ended elsewhere, at boot or in place.
- A session read the server does not answer (a transport error, or an error status other than 401) is not a sign-out and clears nothing. `createAuthClient`'s `getSession()` records whether its `null` was the server's answer; an injected client's `null` is taken as its own statement that there is no session.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`.** A list-filter write still waiting on its debounce is dropped before `signOut()` ends the session, and as soon as the session user goes on any other path, so none lands after the sweep.
- Server-side user preference rows are not written at sign-out.
- Docs: `ui/packages/auth/README.md` gains "Browser storage at sign-out". Changeset: `@object-ui/auth` and `@object-ui/app-shell`, patch.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/auth/src/__tests__/signOut-client-cache-purge-5198.test.tsx`: the sweep keeps only the device and sign-in language keys; a removal that throws costs only that key and is reported; `signOut()`, a boot read that answers no session and an in-place read that answers no session each clear the user's keys; a browser that never held a session keeps its keys; through the real client, a read that ends in a transport error or a 503 clears nothing, and a read answered with no session or a 401 clears the user's keys.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/context/__tests__/signOutPurge.test.tsx`: the real writers fill `list-state` and `list-filters`; `signOut()` and an in-place read that answers no session remove them and keep the sign-in language; whatever is sent to the server row is the state the user left; a search typed just before `signOut()`, or just before a read that answers no session, is not written after it.

## Acceptance notes

- Census of what the console keeps in browser storage at sign-out, outside the two web stores: the sidebar's `sidebar_state` cookie (a collapse flag), the service worker's build-versioned shell cache (static files only; it never stores API responses), and the `@object-ui/mobile` IndexedDB offline queue, which the console does not use. None is cleared here.
- `pnpm check:type-check-debt` and the CI type-check lanes are not measured locally; CI runs them.
